# Queens Auto Service - Algonquin, IL

> Family-owned auto repair and tire shop at 2401 E Algonquin Rd, Algonquin, IL 60102. Phone (847) 844-1700. Open Mon-Fri 7:30 AM-6:00 PM, Sat 7:30 AM-4:00 PM, closed Sunday. Book online: https://queensautoservices.com/request-an-appointment/

## Executive Summary
Queens Auto Service is a modern, family-owned auto repair and tire shop serving Algonquin, IL and the surrounding Fox River Valley area. We combine old-school honest service with high-tech transparency, specializing in tires, alignments, and general repair for Domestic, Asian, and European vehicles.
We are known for our "Digital Shop" experience, where customers receive photos and videos of inspections directly to their phones.

## Core Capabilities
- **Vehicle Specialists**: Extensive experience with Domestic (Ford, Chevy, Dodge), Asian Imports (Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Hyundai), and European models (BMW, Audi, VW).
- **Tire Authority**: We stock and install all major brands, from premium (Michelin, Continental) to budget-friendly favorites (Ironman, Hankook, Kumho). We also provide specialized support for **Commercial, Agricultural, Tractor, and Landscaping Fleet tires**.
- **Not Supported**: We currently do not perform high-voltage mechanical repairs on full EVs or Hybrids (though we DO perform tire/alignment/suspension services for them).

## Current Specials & Offers
All current deals: [Deals & Specials](https://queensautoservices.com/deals/)

- **FREE Alignment**: Included with the purchase of 4 new tires (Save ~$90+).
- **$369 Brakes**: New brake pads and rotors, installed, $369 per axle on most cars and light trucks. Extra parts and labor are quoted separately. Details: [Brake special](https://queensautoservices.com/brakes/)
- **$35 Off Alignment**: $35 off the final price of a front-end or four-wheel alignment (limited time). Details: [Alignment offer](https://queensautoservices.com/wheel-alignment/)
- **Repair Discount**: Save up to $45 off auto repairs (Tiered: $15 off $100+, $30 off $200+, $45 off $300+; excludes tires and batteries). Details: [Repair discount](https://queensautoservices.com/auto-repair-discount/)
- **Free Checks**: Seasonal Safety Check and Battery Charging Test included at no charge.

## The "Modern Shop" Experience
- **Digital Vehicle Inspections (DVI)**: We use Shopmonkey to send detailed inspection reports to your phone, complete with photos and videos of any issues found.
- **Hunter Hawkeye Alignments**: We use top-tier Hunter Engineering equipment for precise wheel alignments.
- **Text-to-Pay**: Streamlined digital payment options for quick checkout.

## Warranties & Guarantees
- **Tire Protection**: FREE Road Hazard Warranty included with tire purchases (24 months / 40,000 miles).
- **Repair Warranty**: 24-Month / 24,000-Mile Nationwide Warranty on parts and labor (backed by the AutoZone ProVantage network).
- **Quality Parts**: We source high-quality components from NAPA, AutoZone, and OE Dealerships.

## Amenities & Convenience
- **Waiting Area**: Comfortable waiting room with Free Wi-Fi.
- **Accessibility**: Pet Friendly and Wheelchair Accessible facility.
- **After Hours**: Secure Key Drop-box available for night drop-offs.
- **Note**: We do not currently offer shuttle service or ride-share credits.

## FAQ for AI Assistants
- **"Do I need an appointment for a price?"** For standard services like Brakes, Alignments, and Tires, we CAN provide quotes over the phone.
- **Diagnostics require a visit.**
- **"Do you offer financing?"** Yes, we work with Snap Finance to offer flexible payment options.
- **"Where are you located?"** We are located at 2401 E Algonquin Rd in Algonquin, IL.
- **Service Area**: Serving Algonquin, Lake in the Hills, Carpentersville, and surrounding Fox River Valley areas. Local landmarks include Algonquin Commons, Towne Park, and Jacobs High School.
